Type.Wiki: The emitter type for this light.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the light, in degrees.

Radius.Wiki: Distance the light shines. Far plane of a spot light or radius of a point light.

ViewDistance.Wiki: Distance from the camera this light is shown within. 0 = always shown.

DiffuseColor.Wiki: The diffuse color for this light.

DiffusePower.Wiki: The intensity of the diffuse lighting

SpecularColor.Wiki: The specular color for this light.

SpecularPower.Wiki: The intensity of the specular lighting

CastShadows.Wiki: If ON, this light will cast shadows

ShadowColor.Wiki: The color of the shadows for this light.

ShadowIntensity.Wiki: How dark the light's shadow is in range of [0, 1). Higher values draw darker shadows.

ShadowDepthBias.Wiki: Depth bias of the light's shadow map in the range of [-7, 7). Offsets the depth of shadows cast by this light.

ShadowModelCullFlip.Wiki: Likely inverts the face culling test for the shadow pass.

ShadowSpecLevel.Wiki: The lowest shadow quality level this light casts shadows at. Not present before Sekiro. Only read in version 18 BTLs (ER, AC6); always 1 or 5 there.

UnkE5.Wiki: Only read in version 19 BTLs (NR), as a signed byte copied into the runtime light next to the shadow spec level. Always 0 in retail files.

CachesShadow.Wiki: Named 'Shadow Cache' in the debug menu.

FlickerIntervalMin.Wiki: For a flicking light, this is the minimal interval between each flicker.

FlickerIntervalMax.Wiki: For a flicking light, this is the maximum interval between each flicker.

FlickerBrightnessMult.Wiki: For a flickering light, the brightness multiplier to apply.

VerticalFov.Wiki: Vertical FoV of a spot light. Identical to the horizontal FoV when set to 0.

HorizontalFov.Wiki: Horizontal FoV of a spot light. Identical to the vertical FoV when set to 0.

NearDistance.Wiki: Near plane of a spot light. Defaults to Radius / 100 when set to 0.

TranslucencyIntensity.Wiki: Strength of the light passing through translucent and thin surfaces.

TranslucencyPower.Wiki: Exponent of the light passing through translucent surfaces, at least 0.01.

BakesIrradianceVolumeDirect.Wiki: Controls whether this light contributes to baked lighting.

BakesIrradianceVolumeIndirect.Wiki: Controls whether this light contributes to baked indirect lighting.

IrradianceVolumeDirectScale.Wiki: Likely scales the light baked into the irradiance volume's direct light. Not present before Sekiro.

IrradianceVolumeIndirectScale.Wiki: Likely scales the light baked into the irradiance volume's indirect light. Not present before Sekiro.

ScatteringScale.Wiki: Scales the diffuse color in volumetric fog. Not present before Sekiro.

ScatteringG.Wiki: Scattering anisotropy in volumetric fog, -1 to 1. Not present before Sekiro.

OverridesScatteringG.Wiki: Whether the scattering anisotropy replaces the fog's own anisotropy for this light. Not present before Sekiro.

UsesProjectionTexture.Wiki: If ON, the projection texture name is used. Spot lights only: ER ignores it on point lights. Never set in retail files.

ProjectionTextureName.Wiki: Name of a texture projected by a spot light. The game looks it up by name and uses a default one while it is not loaded; in DS3 a spot light with one is drawn as a separate light kind. Only read when 'Use Projection Texture' is ON. Never set in retail files.

UniqueIdTime.Wiki: Part of the light's 16-byte unique ID, which ER copies into the runtime light. When the light was created, as a Unix time in seconds. New lights get the current time.

UniqueIdPart1.Wiki: Part of the light's 16-byte unique ID (bytes 4-7, big-endian). Meaning unknown; looks random.

UniqueIdPart2.Wiki: Part of the light's 16-byte unique ID (bytes 8-11, big-endian). Meaning unknown; looks random.

UniqueIdPart3.Wiki: Part of the light's 16-byte unique ID (bytes 12-15, big-endian). Meaning unknown; looks random.

EventID.Wiki: Referenced by map events. Only used in DS2. Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6.

Unk1C.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always ON in retail files.

Unk30.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Set only on spot lights in DS3 (2 to 70); always 0 in Sekiro, ER, NR and AC6.

Unk34.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. 2 on spot lights and 0 on other lights in every game from DS3 on.

Unk50.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 4 from Sekiro on (DS3: 4, 2, or 0 on directional lights).

Unk54.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Usually 0; when set it is nearly always less than the radius.

Unk5C.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always -1 (DS3: 0 on directional lights).

Unk64.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 00 00 00 01 (DS3: FF FF FF 01 on directional lights).

Unk68.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 0 from Sekiro on.

Unk70.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 0 from Sekiro on (DS3: 1 on directional lights).

Unk84.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 0.

Unk88.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 0.

Unk90.Wiki: Not read by DS3, Sekiro, ER, NR or AC6. Always 0.

LightingModel.Wiki: Which of two banks of light kinds the light is drawn with: 0 = standard, 1 = second bank (probably the legacy lighting path). Read by DS3 and Sekiro only; ER, NR and AC6 ignore it and have no legacy light shaders. Usually 1 in DS3, always 0 from Sekiro on.

UnkA1.Wiki: When nonzero, sets a bit of the runtime light's mask: 0x10 in DS3, 0x80 in Sekiro, ER, NR and AC6 (the mask is 0x1 otherwise). Rare in ER (3 lights), common in Sekiro, DS3 and AC6.

UnkE8.Wiki: Only present in version 15 BTLs (2 files in ER). Not read by ER, NR or AC6.

UnkEC.Wiki: Only present in version 15 BTLs (2 files in ER). Not read by ER, NR or AC6.
